summary: Tshilenge territory (Kasai-Oriental), immediately around Mbuji-Mayi, is firmly state-administered and has no known armed group holding territory. Tshilenge town is policed by the PNC with ANR and some FARDC presence; rural Tshilenge and Kasansa secteurs rely on PNC posts and customary chiefs. Violence is mostly banditry and land/chieftaincy disputes; the 2016-2017 Kamuina Nsapu insurgency did not establish lasting control here. Live web research was unavailable in this run, so the assessment rests on background knowledge and default state presence, with limited confidence.

zones.description: Tshilenge town (territory seat; Citenge health zone neighbourhoods Cilenge, Cibumba, Kasensa)
zones.evidence: Territory headquarters with administrator, PNC territorial commissariat, ANR and parquet/tribunal de paix; no armed group is reported to hold the town. Insecurity consists of banditry and occasional local disputes handled by state forces. zones.description: Rural Tshilenge territory: secteurs/groupements of Tshilenge and Kasansa health zones (Kabongo, Cialula, Bena Tshibangu, Muya, Biaya, Lac Lomba, Tshiovo etc.)
zones.evidence: Densely populated Luba rural area south and west of Mbuji-Mayi with no known armed-group territorial control; the 2016-2017 Kamuina Nsapu crisis mainly affected Kasai-Central/Kasai and only sporadically touched Kasai-Oriental, and no militia presence is reported here now. Order rests on PNC posts at secteur/groupement level and customary chiefs, with land/chieftaincy disputes as the main source of violence.
